custom_expected:
Step 4: User C's clock-in succeeds; labor line starts accumulating time.
Step 7: User D does NOT see a clock-in control on labor lines (or sees it disabled). Same role, different per-staff setting -> different behavior. Confirms orthogonality.
custom_preconds: User C (Technician role) has the per-staff 'Time Clock' setting ON. User D (also Technician role) has the per-staff 'Time Clock' setting OFF.
custom_steps:
1. Log in as User C.
2. Open an assigned WO. Locate a labor line.
3. Click the clock-in control on that labor line.
4. Observe behavior.
5. Log out. Log in as User D.
6. Open an assigned WO. Locate a labor line.
7. Look for the clock-in control on that labor line.
title: WO line clock-in is gated by per-staff 'Time Clock' setting on the staff record
